one_line: The official Track the Recovery repo: 48 committed CSVs of Affinity Solutions card spend at national/state/county/city by day and month with income-quartile and industry splits, plus Womply, Burning Glass and Zillow series, 2020 onward; attribution terms, no resale.
abnb_use: Gap 6, named explicitly: daily/county US card spend with an accommodation-and-food-services and arts-and-entertainment cut as a regional consumer-strength and discretionary-travel input to NA nights and ADR.
sample_plan: Raw-fetch data/'Affinity - National - Daily.csv', 'Affinity - State - Daily.csv' and 'Affinity Industry Composition' plus docs/Data Dictionary.md; head the county file rather than taking it whole. Cap 15 MB. Record the last data date — series may stop ~2023.
